name: n25-c1-no-6-crossing-family-graz-prague
description: Set of 25 points which does not contain a crossing family of size 6 or more.
reference: B. Aronov, P. Erdos, W. Goddard, D.J. Kleitman, M. Klugerman, J. Pach, L.J. Schulman, Crossing families. Combinatorica 14 (1994), 127-134 (upper-bound argument). Example obtained within Graz-Prague bilateral project CZ 18-2015, 'Erdos-Szekeres type questions for point sets'.
note: Same labeled order type as crossing-families/n25-c1-no-6-crossing-family (Fig. 6 of the crossing families paper), other coordinates.
